children: Spain's Repsol will get a boost from elevated refining margins into 2027 that will likely drive consensus estimates higher, Berenberg analysts write. This could then drive another strong year for shareholder distributions, they say. The analysts raise their 2027 refining indicator margin estimate to $15 a barrel from $12, which drives an 11% increase in the bank's adjusted net income estimate. Shares fall 1.2% to 30.35 euros.(adam.whittaker@wsj.com)
